philosophy.title: Concept-driven design
philosophy.text: Every project begins with a single clear idea — drawn from site, climate and brief — that guides every decision that follows.

philosophy.title: Functional spaces
philosophy.text: Beauty that works. Plans are tested against daily life so rooms flow, store well and adapt over time.

philosophy.title: Sustainable materials
philosophy.text: We favour honest, local and long-lived materials, and passive strategies that reduce energy use from the start.

philosophy.title: Attention to detail
philosophy.text: The joint, the threshold, the handle. Precision at the smallest scale is what makes a space feel complete.

process.title: Discovery
process.text: We listen, visit the site and understand your brief, budget and timeline in depth.
process.alt: Existing house and garden surveyed during discovery

process.title: Concept Development
process.text: Sketches, massing models and mood boards establish the big idea and the direction.
process.alt: Architect sketching concept plans by hand

process.title: Design & Planning
process.text: Plans, elevations and 3D views are refined with you until every space is resolved.
process.alt: Photoreal 3D view of a living space developed in design

process.title: Documentation
process.text: Coordinated working drawings, specifications and approvals ready for tender and construction.
process.alt: Precise white façade reflecting resolved construction drawings

process.title: Execution & Supervision
process.text: Regular site visits and reporting keep quality, cost and programme on track to handover.
process.alt: Studio team reviewing progress on a construction site

testimonials.name: Neha Sharma — The Courtyard House
testimonials.message: They understood how our family lives better than we did. The courtyard has become the centre of our home, and the house stays cool even in May.

testimonials.name: Arjun Kapoor — White Ledge Villa
testimonials.message: From the first sketch to the final snag list the studio was precise, calm and honest about cost. The villa is exactly what we imagined, only better.

testimonials.name: Facilities Head — Meridian Analytics
testimonials.message: A workplace our team actually wants to come back to. Delivered on programme, and flexible enough that we've already reconfigured twice without builders.

testimonials.name: Riya Iyer — Ivory Apartment
testimonials.message: The 3D walkthroughs made every decision easy. The finished apartment is serene — friends ask for the designer's number every time they visit.

faq.a: For full architectural commissions we usually charge a percentage of construction cost, staged against design milestones. Interiors, drawings-only and consultancy work can be fixed-fee. We confirm everything in writing after the first consultation.
Yes. We work across India, combining site visits at key milestones with remote design reviews.

faq.q: How long does a typical house take?
faq.a: Design and approvals usually take four to six months, and construction twelve to eighteen months depending on size and specification.

faq.q: Can you work with my contractor?
faq.a: Absolutely. We can prepare tender drawings for competitive pricing or coordinate with a builder you already trust, with our supervision on site.
